title: THE HOLY SPIRIT

blocks.text: THE HOLY SPIRIT In this special writing let us study the fascinating subject of the amazing Holy Spirit. Rev. 12 reveals “the sun clothed woman, the church of the ages, even the New Testament Church!” – It is this one the Holy Spirit deals with up and until the end of the age! – And in Rev. Chap. 17, this mystery woman represents the false churches of the ages even unto the end of her judgment! – Satan’s emissaries abide in this huge system…And false doctrine will work into the churches preparing for the anti-Christ! – “And the Lord Jesus will be working with the sun clothed woman with the moon under her feet until He appears and translates His elect! – And the rest of her seed will go through the Tribulation!” “Now our main subject is to reveal how the Holy Spirit will work with His people. The Old Testament spoke about the coming of the refreshing and the rest, the phenomena of the Holy Spirit would deal with us just before the end of the age!” Isa. 28:12 – “It will be a fiery anointing to quicken the believer into a miraculous power working divine wonders! (Acts. 2:4) – And just as the Old Testament predicted, a rushing mighty wind shook the believer and tongues of fire appeared upon them! And they spake in other tongues and heavenly languages as the Scriptures foretold!” – Acts 2:38 says, “those baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus shall receive the baptism of the Holy Spirit! – As Jesus said beforehand, the kingdom of God is within you! – So express it, act upon it and use it!…Some people quake and tremble, some in stammering lips, while other go deeper into tongues of men and angels!” (Isa. 28:11) – “While others feel a burning confidence within, a desire to believe all of the Word of God and doing exploits! – Many feel an excitement of great joy and the real Holy Spirit believer is always waiting and looking for the coming of the Lord Jesus; they are expecting Him to return!” So we see it is the refreshing rest promised to God’s people just before the end of the age, and it has been occurring greatly in our generation! And more is coming! – Joel 2:28-30, “I will restore saith the Lord; the former and the latter rain!” This is a very deep subject and we could go on with this, but we must point out some very important facts! Here are some definite promises of the Holy Spirit! – It is promised to be with the believer until the end of the age. (St. Matt. 28:20) – Other Scriptures verify He is to be in the midst of the believer and shall comfort them! The Holy Spirit shall be given to those that ask! – “The spirit shall be a well of water springing up into everlasting life!” (John 4:14) – “From the believer shall flow rivers of living water.” (John 7:37-39) – The word ‘rivers’ reveals the Holy Spirit will operate in various channels and gifts through the believer! – In John 20:22 it says, “Receive ye the Holy Ghost and Jesus breathed upon them!” And now the work of the Holy Spirit. – “He will reprove the world of sin, righteousness and judgment. (St. John 16:8) – The Holy Spirit source of new birth! – It says it blows mysteriously like the wind!…It reveals no one orders it where to go and when to go, (John 3:8) but it goes in providence to the hearts that long for it! – And shall quicken the believer in healing, restoration, resurrection and translation!” (John 6:63) – “He shall testify of Christ, shall teach you all things, shall reveal deep revelation unfolding the secrets of God to His elect…He shall guide you into all truth. The Lord will reveal the real truth of the Scriptures in power. And He shall show you things to come!” (John 16:13) – And we shall see in the Scripts and literature that the Lord is doing these things to a special people being prepared! – He will show us coming events concerning His work and soon return! – “The Holy Spirit shall give power to witness, even to the utmost parts of the earth!” (Acts 1:8) – “And one more thing that sometimes people overlook. The Holy Spirit is definitely sent in the name of the Lord Jesus! (John 14:26) – In fact the fullness of the Godhead dwelleth in Him bodily!” (Col. 2:9) – Verse 10 says, “He is the head of all principality and power!” – He will give the believer boldness to believe, and faith to work signs, wonders and miracles! And as it says, He shall give you power over all power of the enemy!…And Jesus gave this promise, “The works that I do ye shall do and even greater works when the Holy Spirit is sent back in my name!” (John 14:12) – “As scores of Scriptures bear out, Jesus was God in the flesh!” St. John 1:1, 10, read verse 14, complete answer, Isa. 9:6! “At the end of the age in the Thunders, Rev. 10:1-4, the Holy Spirit will be really moving among His people. As we see it is associated to the calling of time!” Rev. 4:3, “And the 7 thunders come out of the 7 lightning's of God, wherein 7 lamps of fire will give us light in these perilous times! (Rev. 4:5) – And changing and translating us! – These lightning's and lamps are the 7 spirits of God, meaning the 7 revelations of God, but all are of one Holy Spirit light manifesting 7 different ways, like the rainbow!” (Verse 3) “It’s like looking into the heavens and seeing one bolt of lightning forking out in 7 directions, still of the same bolt of lightning! Also verses 1 and 2 typifies the translation!” “Behold saith the Lord, I will restore all before My return, move with the wind of My spirit for it is all around you! – I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour My spirit upon thy seed!” (Isa. 44:3) – “Notice it says, to him that is thirsty (desiring)…it says, dry ground (meaning, where it has not been poured out in a long time will be floods of His spirit!)” Isa. 41:18. “According to many other Scriptures and prophecies we should look for a doubling up and tripling of God’s outpouring! – I believe those here in my work and those on my mailing list shall receive one of the greatest moves of God’s power ever seen before!” – “Yea saith the Lord, delight thyself in My spirit and I shall give thee the desires of thine heart! (Ps. 37:4) – O taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man that trusteth in Him!” (Ps. 34:8) – “My, you can’t help but to feel such a powerful anointing! As you pray and seek the Lord, great and mighty things will He do for His people!”
